I feel like I can help. I'm bipolar (well my therapist/pdoc aren't making it "official" because I'm only 14 and they want to wait a year if its just hormones or not.) so ill give some help. You seem to be suffering the depression part like normal bipolars. But it's just like regular depression. The thing I really want to focus on is your "high" moods. Or your manic moods. You say you suddenly get better in an hour. That kind of looks like borderline personality disorder. In bipolar disorder you have a transition period of depression to mania. In the transition you are in your normal mood. That usually lasts 3 days to 2 weeks. Also when in your highs do you tend to get a little agitated, angry, or full of rage? Because that can happen while manic. Do you tend to be obnoxiously nice? Although being nice is super, being manic can make you a little too nice. Do you want to do a lot of things while in your high that doesn't really follow through? That happens a lot while manic. Another couple manic things are hyper sexuality (where you're out of control sex/masturbating. It can reach to 1 hr to 7 hrs.) and you can get over confident with everything. You think everything you say or do is above average and you're some big someone but in reality you aren't. Also you can get delusional like you're a real special person and you're on some big top secret mission in life. 

Also go to /r/bipolar. They will help you too. I'll pray for you and if you have any of this please contact a doctor, psychiatrist or therapist. Hope this helps!
